title: "ALA NSW/QLD filtering summary"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
config <- yaml::read_yaml("../config/ala_crabs.yml")
database <- "../data/derived/ala_raw.sqlite"
```

# Purpose

This report traces the number of records and candidate names from the combined NSW/QLD ALA download through the rank filter, candidate generation, manual review, Entrez checks, and CRABS export.

# Raw database

```{r raw}
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), database)
raw <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS records FROM ala_occurrences_raw")
raw_ranks <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT taxonRank, COUNT(*) AS records FROM ala_occurrences_raw GROUP BY taxonRank ORDER BY records DESC")
raw_phyla <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT phylum, COUNT(*) AS records FROM ala_occurrences_raw GROUP BY phylum ORDER BY records DESC")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
raw
raw_ranks
head(raw_phyla, 20)
```

# Candidate filtering

```{r stages}
count_rows <- function(path, chunk = 64 * 1024^2) {
  con <- file(path, "rb"); on.exit(close(con)); n <- 0
  repeat { b <- readBin(con, "raw", chunk); if (!length(b)) break; n <- n + sum(b == as.raw(10L)) }
  n - 1  # minus header
}
target_rows <- count_rows("../data/derived/target_occurrences.csv")
candidates <- fread("../data/derived/name_candidates.csv")
normalised <- fread("../data/derived/name_candidates_normalised.csv")
review <- fread("../data/derived/taxonomy_review_queue.csv")

data.table(
  stage = c("Raw records", "Target records", "Candidate observations", "Normalised names", "Review queue names"),
  count = c(
    raw$records,
    target_rows,
    nrow(candidates),
    uniqueN(normalised$normalised_name),
    nrow(review)
  )
)
```

# Taxonomic exclusions

The target filter retains species and infraspecific ranks and conservatively excludes clearly non-pollen phyla/classes configured in `Scripts/config/ala_crabs.yml`. ALA phylum/class fields are not trusted alone because this export contains inconsistent hierarchy assignments.

# Manual decisions

```{r decisions}
matches <- fread("../data/derived/taxonomy_matches.csv", na.strings=c("", "NA"))
matches[, .N, by=decision][order(decision)]
```

# Region flags

Each region in `geography.region_flags` is a latitude/longitude box. A species is flagged for a region when all its georeferenced records lie inside the box (e.g. `fnq_only`: every record north of Cairns). Flagged species stay in the CRABS list unless the region has `exclude: true`; a hit on one should be checked before it is trusted.

```{r regions}
flags_file <- "../data/derived/species_latitude_flags.csv"
region_file <- "../output/audit/region_flagged_species.csv"
if (file.exists(flags_file)) {
  flags <- fread(flags_file)
  regions <- sub("^n_inside_", "", grep("^n_inside_", names(flags), value = TRUE))
  in_list <- if (file.exists(region_file)) fread(region_file)[, .(species_binomial, in_crabs_list)] else NULL
  data.table(
    region = regions,
    flagged_species = vapply(regions, function(r) sum(flags[[r]] %in% TRUE), integer(1)),
    in_crabs_list = vapply(regions, function(r) {
      if (is.null(in_list)) return(NA_integer_)
      sp <- flags[get(r) %in% TRUE, species_binomial]
      sum(in_list[species_binomial %chin% sp, in_crabs_list] %in% TRUE)
    }, integer(1))
  )
}
```

# Entrez and CRABS output

```{r final}
entrez_file <- "../data/derived/entrez_marker_checks.csv"
entrez <- fread(entrez_file)
if ("ncbi_its_hits" %in% names(entrez)) setnames(entrez, "ncbi_its_hits", "ncbi_marker_hits")
crabs <- readLines("../output/crabs/crabs_species_list.txt", warn = FALSE)
exclusions <- fread("../output/audit/exclusions.csv")

list(
  reviewed_species_checked = nrow(entrez),
  final_crabs_names = length(crabs),
  excluded_rows = nrow(exclusions),
  marker = if (nrow(entrez) && "marker" %in% names(entrez)) unique(entrez$marker) else "ITS",
  species_with_marker_sequences = if (nrow(entrez) == 0) 0 else sum(entrez$ncbi_marker_hits > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
)

head(crabs, 100)
```
